name: TX-13
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Ronny Jackson running with $5.4M cash on hand
model.rationale: The R+23 district, a well-funded incumbent with $5.4 million on hand, and a challenger who raised only about $102K all point to an easy Republican hold, and prediction markets agree at roughly 94% for Jackson.
model.watch: A major scandal or unexpected incumbent retirement would be the main route to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
TX-13 is one of the most Republican-leaning districts in the country, with a partisan lean of R+23. Incumbent Ronny Jackson is running for reelection and holds a commanding financial advantage, with $5.4 million on hand after raising over $4 million, plus outside support on his side. Democratic challenger Mark Nair has raised only about $102,000 and has minimal cash available.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Jackson roughly a 94% chance of winning. With no evidence of a competitive dynamic, the seat is expected to remain safely in Republican hands.
